semiconductor_relevance: High — HIPURITY Corporation specializes in gas purification systems critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: HIPURITY Corporation provides specialized gas purifiers, including In-Line Purifiers and Getter Purifiers, essential for maintaining ultra-high purity (UHP) gas environments in semiconductor fabrication. Their products support various gas handling and monitoring applications, ensuring compliance with stringent industry standards.

regional_presence.Korea: HIPURITY Corporation operates in South Korea, focusing on providing gas purification solutions for the semiconductor industry.
